Airbnb listings in Melbourne and regional Victoria

Source: R/data.R
vic_listings.Rd

One row per Airbnb listing in the newest Inside Airbnb snapshots for Melbourne, the Mornington Peninsula and Barwon South West (which covers Geelong, the Bellarine and the Great Ocean Road). Listing names, descriptions and the names of small hosts are left out.

Usage

vic_listings

Format

A tibble with one row per listing and these columns:

id

Airbnb listing ID.

region

Inside Airbnb file the listing came from.

snapshot

Date Inside Airbnb collected the data.

zone

Broad area, such as "Great Ocean Road" or "Melbourne CBD".

place

Town the listing is matched to (see vic_places), or its council area when it is not near any listed town.

lga

Local government area (council) as given by Inside Airbnb.

latitude, longitude

Approximate location. Airbnb blurs these by up to about 150 metres.

room_type

"Entire home/apt", "Private room", "Hotel room" or "Shared room".

property_type

Host's own description, such as "Entire cottage".

is_hotel

TRUE for hotel rooms and serviced apartments listed on Airbnb.

stay_type

"Short stay (under 28 nights)" or "Mid stay (28 nights or more)", based on the minimum stay. The 28-night line follows Victoria's short stay levy.

minimum_nights

Shortest stay the host accepts.

bedrooms

Number of bedrooms, with 4 meaning four or more.

price

Nightly price in Australian dollars on the day of the snapshot. Missing when the host had no dates open.

host_id

Airbnb host ID.

host_listings

Listings this host runs across all three regions.

host_tier

"Single listing", "2 to 9 listings" or "10 or more listings".

operator

Host name, kept only for hosts with 10 or more listings.

availability_365

Nights open for booking in the next year.

number_of_reviews_ltm

Reviews in the last 12 months.

active

TRUE if the listing had a review in the last 12 months.

Source

Inside Airbnb, https://insideairbnb.com/get-the-data/, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Prepared by data-raw/02_airbnb.R.
